features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Single-Pass Printing Architecture
items.desc: The Rocket prints in a single continuous pass at industrial speed, eliminating multi-pass carriage movement and enabling output volumes that no scanning printer in its class can match.

items.title: Variable Ink Droplet Technology
items.desc: Piezoelectric printheads with 5, 7, and 12 picolitre variable droplet sizes deliver smooth gradients, sharp fine detail, and rich solid fills within the same print job.

items.title: Automated Printhead Cleaning Station
items.desc: Onboard self-cleaning system handles printhead maintenance automatically, extending head operational life and reducing manual intervention during long production shifts.

items.title: Adjustable Suction Platform
items.desc: Active suction across the print zone holds fabric flat and uniform throughout the pass, ensuring consistent ink placement accuracy regardless of fabric weight or surface texture.

items.title: Tension-Controlled Feeding and Winding
items.desc: Servo motors combined with laser-guided coil diameter sensors maintain precise, uniform fabric tension from unwind through winding, eliminating stretch and registration errors.

items.title: Auto Humidity and Surface Wiping System
items.desc: Automated humidity control and surface wiping maintain stable printhead performance throughout the run while reducing fabric defects and material waste.

items.title: Stable Ink Supply System with Degassing
items.desc: Peristaltic pump delivery with automatic negative pressure control and inline degassing ensures smooth, uninterrupted ink flow to all heads across extended high-speed production runs.

items.title: Industrial Inline Design
items.desc: Fabric entry, printing, drying, and collection are fully integrated into one automated inline system, removing manual handling between stages and maximising throughput efficiency.

items.title: Digital + Rotary Integration
items.desc: Integrates digital and rotary printing in one workflow, allowing for precise registration and special effects like gold, pearl, and puff.

items.title: Ink and Colour Efficiency
items.desc: Provides a 10–15% savings in ink consumption and a 15% improvement in colour performance.

items.title: Online Sizing
items.desc: Features Online Sizing for seamless front-to-back production, real-time quality control, and reduced waste and labour costs.

items.title: Fully Integrated In-Line Coating
items.desc: Allows for registered, design-based selective coating that saves paste costs and reduces wastewater impact.

items.title: Special Effect Overlays
items.desc: Supports complex special effect overlays such as gold, pearl, and puff, utilizing patented technology and precise camera registration.

items.title: Modular Hardware Design
items.desc: Includes distinct units for fabric infeed, dust removal/flattening, two rotary screens for online coating, digital printing, two rotary screens for foil/bloch printing, drying, and fabric outfeed.

showcase.heading: Single Pass Digital Textile Printer
showcase.description: The world's fastest digital textile printer in its class. Single-pass architecture, up to 70,000 lm/day, 2588mm print width, and full inline automation built for manufacturers who operate at mass-production scale.

table.heading: Fabric and Ink Selection for Single Pass Digital Textile Printing
table.intro: At up to 70,000 metres a day, the wrong ink choice gets repeated across the whole run. Match the ink to the fibre first.
table.note: On single pass, fabric consistency matters as much as ink. Keep fabric sources and pretreatment uniform across rolls to avoid colour shifts in a batch. The 2,588 mm print width fits double bedsheets in a single width.

sections.heading: Real-World Production Capacity
sections.note: After roll changes, design changes and maintenance, 70,000 metres a day is realistic across three shifts. That's a 1 lakh metre order in under 2 days. But plan your pretreatment, steaming and washing lines to match, because at these speeds downstream capacity is usually the real limit.

sections.heading: Infrastructure and Setup Requirements
paragraphs: Plan floor space for the full inline line plus pretreatment, finishing and roll storage. You'll need stable power with backup, fixation equipment sized to Rocket's output, bulk ink storage with a reliable supply, and water and effluent treatment if you print reactive or acid. Staff each shift with a print operator, fabric handlers and someone for RIP and colour profiles, and agree service response times in advance.

sections.heading: Quality Control During Continuous Production
paragraphs: At 90 m/min, a problem missed for 10 minutes affects 900 metres. Rocket's inline degassing prevents air bubbles, a main cause of nozzle dropouts, while variable droplets (5–18 pl) give fine detail and solid coverage in one pass. On the floor, run nozzle checks at every shift start, use fabric-specific colour profiles, check fabric tension at feeding and inspect fabric at collection so problems are caught during the run.

faq.heading: Rocket: Single Pass Digital Textile Printer

items.q: What is a single pass digital textile printer?
items.a: A single pass digital textile printer uses fixed rows of printheads that cover the full fabric width. The fabric passes underneath once and the whole design is printed in that one pass, which makes it much faster than scanning printers.
Rocket prints at 60, 75 or 90 metres per minute, with a production capacity of up to 70,000 linear metres a day.

items.q: What is the maximum print width?
items.a: Rocket prints up to 2,588 mm wide, which fits wide home textiles like double bedsheets in a single width.

items.q: What does it cost to print per metre?
items.a: Ink cost averages about ₹4.2 per metre, from around ₹2.5 for light designs up to ₹5.8 for deep designs.

items.q: Can Rocket replace rotary screen printing?
items.a: For many jobs, yes. Rocket reduces production turnaround from 30 days to 5 because there are no screens to engrave. It can also combine digital printing with rotary screen printing in a single pass.

items.q: Which inks and fabrics does Rocket support?
items.a: Rocket supports reactive, acid, pigment and disperse inks on all fabric types, including elastic and new-generation fibres.

items.q: How many printheads does Rocket use?
items.a: Rocket is scalable up to 212 printheads, with 4 to 8 colours.
